note: Regional park 1 km south of Macklin beside Macklin Lake, with a diked swim area and beach, a stocked trout pond, six ball diamonds and a 9-hole golf course with a licensed clubhouse. Treed sites; seasonal campers are kept to their own area. --Claude
summary: Keep (regional park). 164 sites (79 full service, 73 power, 12 tent) + overflow/group on Let's Camp; C$20-45, entry C$5/day; 50 A; season May 1 - Oct 31; Let's Camp booking. Count 120 -> 164, electric 30 -> 50. Phone 306-753-2075 -> 306-753-2175. Not waterfront kept. Pin fine. Google 4.3 (60).
flags: PHONE: stored 306-753-2075 -> 306-753-2175 (Saskatchewan Regional Parks page 'Campground Phone (306) 753-2175', Let's Camp phoneNumber and Google all give 2175).

LONG-STAY (local): 'Seasonal campsites are available upon request and allocated to a certain area' (regional-parks page); seasonal C$4,200 and monthly rates posted. Let's Camp lists 170 public sites (numbered 2-124 plus 24 group 'GS' and 30 overflow 'OF'), so the numbered loops are bookable online; the seasonal count is not posted, so the nightly share is unmeasured but looks well over half. No discouraging wording.
BOOKING: Bunnock week (August long weekend) carries a 'minimum 4 day booking' - an event-week minimum, not a standing one; put in booking.note only.
GOOGLE: 'Macklin Lake Regional Park' 4.3 (60 reviews); the place also covers the golf course and clubhouse.
FEES: base C$20 is the non-serviced class; Let's Camp sells overflow sites OF16-OF30 (no power) to RVs up to 32 ft, so it counts. Cheapest electric C$35.
WATERFRONT: 'not waterfront' kept. The loops lie east of a row of lakeshore cottages and the small stocked trout pond (well under 5 acres); no campsite row is on open ground at the lake.

PIN: stored 52.32100,-109.93990 sits at the west edge of the campground beside the trout pond; the loops spread 100-250 m east. Keep (regional-parks GPS 52.32530,-109.93618 is ~550 m NE at the ball diamonds).
